    • retryManaged

      @CopilotExperimental public CompletableFuture<SessionPluginsRetryManagedResult> retryManaged()
      Installs or updates the plugins the session's managed settings require now, without waiting for the next automatic attempt after a failure, then reloads plugins. Reports progress and failures with the same `session.info` and `session.warning` events as automatic preparation. Fails when the runtime does not prepare managed plugins for the session.

      Invokes the method with no params, applying the runtime defaults.

      Since:
      1.0.0

    • retryManaged

      @CopilotExperimental public CompletableFuture<SessionPluginsRetryManagedResult> retryManaged(SessionPluginsRetryManagedParams params)
      Installs or updates the plugins the session's managed settings require now, without waiting for the next automatic attempt after a failure, then reloads plugins. Reports progress and failures with the same `session.info` and `session.warning` events as automatic preparation. Fails when the runtime does not prepare managed plugins for the session.

      Note: the sessionId field in the params record is overridden by the session-scoped wrapper; any value provided is ignored.
